correctness.rationale: For noncollinear distinct circle nodes v_j=m w_j-1 maps exact constant/first-moment quadrature to a full-dimensional centered zonotope; LP duality gives the projected-median support function. On every strict-order chamber its support is linear in u and the ratio of linear sinusoidal functionals is monotone or constant, so chord normals suffice. Compact Lipschitz empirical-process SLLN gives uniform support/m -> 2/pi; bivariate CLT Cov=I/2 then yields the stated 1-exp(-4c^2/pi^2) Rayleigh CDF. Edge cases m=3, S_m=0, c=0 and t<1 for strict positivity are correctly scoped. New independent SciPy primal LP vs median chord formula checks on 72 seeded random instances have max abs error 8.88e-15. Finite checking does not establish the almost-sure or distributional limit.
